newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium's Sioen Ind to list on Brussels bourse.
newsitem.headline: Belgium's Sioen Ind to list on Brussels bourse.

text.p: Belgian textile company Sioen Industries will list on the Brussels stock exchange's second-tier double-fixing market on October 18, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
The European leader in the coating of textile products, Sioen Industries will offer 600,000 shares, or 30.1 percent of its capital, to the public at 1,400 francs per share.
The company posted group net profit of 130 million francs for first-half 1996, of 173 million francs in full year 1995, and 81 million francs in 1994.
The public offer, underwritten by Generale de Banque, opens on September 30 and closes on October 8.

The coating division accounts for 63 percent of Sioen's forecast 1996 turnover of 3.45 billion francs, and the protective clothing manufacturing business is expected to contribute 31 percent of full-year turnover.
"The stock market listing will permit the company to attract, if necessary, the means to finance its future expansion," said Sioen's founder Jean-Jacques Sioen.
